holiday_set.note: Only the Day of German Unity is federal; every other public holiday is set by the Land, so Calendar needs the household's Land to offer the set in full.

inspection_label.note: The Abgasuntersuchung has been part of the Hauptuntersuchung since 2010, but HU/AU is still how it is named, and colloquially TÜV after one of the testing organisations; PRD 13 writes HU/AU (TÜV).

name.note: The federal authority, the BfDI, as its own site names it in German and in English (bfdi.bund.de/EN). The office is named for its holder, die or der Bundesbeauftragte (BDSG § 8): der since 1 October 2026, so the name changes with the next. Czech, Slovak and Polish have no established name for it, and carry the German one.

url.note: Germany has a supervisory authority in each Land beside the federal one, and a complaint about a private body goes to a Land's. So the address is not a complaint form but the federal authority's own list of the Länder's authorities: which of them is theirs, a person finds there. The same list is in English under /EN/.
